tool_input.command:
cd /workspace/task && cat > solve.py << 'EOF'
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill, Border, Side

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
test = wb['Test']
master = wb['master']

yellow = PatternFill(start_color='FFFF00', end_color='FFFF00', fill_type='solid')
border = Border(left=Side(style='thin'), right=Side(style='thin'),
               top=Side(style='thin'), bottom=Side(style='thin'))

vals = []
for row in range(1, test.max_row+1):
    c = test.cell(row=row, column=1)
    fill = c.fill
    isyellow = fill and fill.fgColor and (fill.fgColor.rgb in ('FFFFFF00','00FFFF00','FFFF00'))
    if isyellow and c.value is not None:
        vals.append(c.value)

print(len(vals))
for i, v in enumerate(vals, start=1):
    cell = master.cell(row=1, column=i, value=v)
    cell.fill = yellow
    cell.border = border

# clear any leftover in row 1 beyond these (up to AH1)
for col in range(len(vals)+1, 35):
    c = master.cell(row=1, column=col)
    c.value = None
    c.fill = PatternFill()
    c.border = Border()

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
EOF
